decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 7 October 2003, the matter described above is lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reasons:

The proposed extension to the dwellinghouse with rear dormer dimensions of 4.85m long by 3.45m deep with a height of 2.4m, that adds 20.08m3, and the hip to gable having dimensions of 4.85m long by 3.45m deep and 2.4m high that is 6.62m3, providing a total volume of 26.7m3, qualifies as Class B permitted development within Part 1 of Schedule 2 of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995. 

The proposed rear roof extension therefore, does not require planning permission.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the proposed erection of a roof extension incorporating a hip to gable roof and rear dormer window to existing dwellinghouse.
